text: Being here fills me with a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The first space, glass-walled and sterile, feels like an antechamber to ideas—quiet, almost expectant, as if it were waiting for thought to take form. The second image, vibrant and alive with text and visuals about research and development, feels emotionally invigorating. Here, the colors and concepts provoke contemplation about our relationship with technology and progress. I feel as though I am on the threshold of discovery, a participant in the unfolding dialogue between innovation and humanity.
